name: deck
description: Deck: a read-only sidebar with a shiba (and a cat), a grid of your own daily jobs, task-list progress, usage and rate limits, model tokens and estimated cost, and the current turn. Forked from Flightdeck by Stephen Casella.

catName.title: Cat name
catName.description: Name shown beside the shiba's for the cat

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the shiba, or keep it still

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone whose midnight starts a new day for the daily grid

reminderHour.title: Reminder hour
reminderHour.description: Hour (0-23, in the time zone above) from which the shiba barks about jobs still pending today; -1 turns the reminder off

jobs.title: Daily jobs
jobs.description: Your daily jobs, as name=pattern entries separated by ; (up to 6). A job counts as done for the day when Claude runs a Bash command matching its pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression) and the command succeeds. Example: backup=scripts/backup\.sh; report=make report

paneColumns.title: Pane width
paneColumns.description: Columns the pane asks for when docked beside the fullscreen transcript, 32 or more

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts
